text:
Maya Patel: Quick FYI — I pulled a sample and ~120 accounts in Onboarding are stuck >14 days, median healthscore = 20. Suspect template merge broke the nudge playbook.
Samir Khan: ugh. do you have query? can run a quick re-eval.
Maya Patel: here:
```sql
SELECT account_id, onboarding_state, last_touch, health_score
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE onboarding_state='Onboarding' AND last_touch < now() - interval '14 days';
```
Maya Patel: results in the report: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4821
Jonah Ruiz: tagging @Lina Chen — can you check the playbook automation logs? might be webhook failing
Lina Chen: on it. I see a spike of 500 errors for playbook-runner webhook between 2024-05-02T03:00 and 03:05 UTC. Investigating root cause.
Lina Chen: looks like the template_id mapping JSON changed — payload now has `template_id` nested under `metadata`. our playbook rule expects top-level `template_id`.
Samir Khan: quick patch: add a tolerant extractor in the playbook rule. I can rollout a hotfix to staging.
Maya Patel: thanks. Can we also re-run the queued playbook jobs for affected accounts? Need to avoid double-nudging.
playbook-runner-bot: ✅ queued 120 replays for job-run 2024-05-02T04:12Z (run_id: pr-20240502-84)
Jonah Ruiz: Suggestion: add idempotency token on per-account nudges and add a backoff window in runner (48h).
Lina Chen: agreed. I'll implement idempotency and fallback to older payload shape for the next 7 days.
Maya Patel: also want a quick CS-facing dashboard card for 'stuck >7 days' — can someone add to the Weeklies board? short-term metric.
Samir Khan: I'll add a telemetry counter and emit metric cs.onboarding.stuck.batch with tags template_id, region.
Maya Patel: perfect. Also capture qualitative feedback: re: nudge copy not matching new template variables — can we add a lightweight feedback flag in the playbook result? like feedback_needed:true
Lina Chen: yep — storing feedback pointer to /cs/feedback/{account_id} on result. we'll surface in the enablement queue.
Jonah Ruiz: assign owners: Maya -> gather sample & comms, Lina -> fix + idempotency rollout, Samir -> metrics + replays, I'll create a postmortem doc.
Maya Patel: thanks team :thumbsup:
Samir Khan: one more — can we gate future template merges with a smoke-run that checks playbook-runner schema? small PR check.
Lina Chen: will add a CI smoke test. ping me if you want to pair on the JSON schema.
playbook-runner-bot: incident update: playbook-runner webhook rate-limited by external service, escalated to eng-infra. Ticket INF-652 created.
Maya Patel: wrapping up — planned next steps in #cs-ops-docs, will post summary by EOD.
Jonah Ruiz: noted. Thanks everyone.
